description: This file defines the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class, which manages execution approval requests by handling incoming events, deciding whether to prompt the user, and resolving decisions based on security policies and allowlists. It includes functions for starting/stopping the polling loop, processing approval requests, and determining presentation and fallback logic.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: Manages execution approval requests by listening for approval events, evaluating whether to prompt the user, and resolving decisions based on security policies and allowlist entries. It includes nested types for request data and presentation decisions.

classes.name: GatewayApprovalRequest
classes.description: A Codable struct representing an approval request, including identifiers, timestamps, and the prompt request details.

classes.name: PresentationDecision
classes.description: A struct encapsulating whether to ask the user, whether presentation is possible, security level, fallback policy, and allowlist entries.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the asynchronous task to listen for incoming approval events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing approval listening task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop to subscribe to approval events stream and handle incoming pushes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a push event, decodes approval request, and resolves decision or prompts user based on policies.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Determines if the approval request should be presented to the user based on current app state and policies.

methods.name: fallbackDecision
methods.description: Calculates fallback decision when prompting is not possible, based on fallback policies and allowlists.

methods.name: fallbackResolution
methods.description: Resolves the executable command or path for allowlist matching.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a command string.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Static method to decide if prompt should be shown under specific conditions.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves seconds since the last user input event.
